dataset.name: Marshfield stage-II colon-cancer cohort (GSE152430)
dataset.description: Independent stage-II colon-cancer cohort with FFPE bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall-survival follow-up.
dataset.cohort_context: The Marshfield Clinic cohort contains 49 pathologist-reviewed stage-II colon cancers resected from 49 patients. TRACE Explorer retains the 48 tumors with positive complete overall-survival time and status; one death is excluded because GEO reports no survival time.

metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Ribosomal-RNA-depleted whole-transcriptome sequencing of FFPE primary colon tumors; reads were aligned with Rsubread to Ensembl release 90, counted with featureCounts and converted to TPM
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-provided overall survival in days for a stage-II surgical colon-cancer cohort with at least five years of clinical follow-up
metadata.endpoint_caveat: GEO labels the endpoint days_to_death_or_censor and provides year and age at surgery, but does not explicitly define the time origin in the deposited metadata. TRACE Explorer preserves the source endpoint without claiming a harmonized postoperative origin.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The title pattern selects all 49 source-designated colon-cancer tumors. GSM4615226, patient 90090, is excluded because it is marked as a death but has NA survival time. Every retained tumor represents one patient.
metadata.disease_selection_note: All source profiles are pathologist-reviewed stage-II colon cancers and are assigned to TCGA-COAD; no rectal tumors are included.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The source-provided matrix contains 58,206 unique Ensembl release 90 gene identifiers and TPM values for all 49 tumors. TRACE Explorer selects the 48 endpoint-complete columns, maps identifiers with the pinned release 90 GTF and applies log2(TPM + 1).
metadata.additional_endpoint_note: GEO also reports individual distant-metastasis time and status for 47 patients, including seven events. The current release registers OS only because the GEO adapter materializes one source time/event pair per study specification.
metadata.overlap_note: The Marshfield cohort is institutionally and accession-wise distinct from the promoted Japanese GSE192667 colon cohort and other external COAD releases.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the pinned public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Pathologist-reviewed FFPE stage-II primary colon tumor, one bulk RNA profile per patient

expression.label: GEO gene-level TPM transformed to log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 90 GRCh38 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: The 58,206 source Ensembl identifiers are unique. Symbols mapped from more than one Ensembl row are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous gene-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) to source-provided gene-level TPM. Values are intended for within-cohort analysis and are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Source-provided overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Source-defined clinical origin, not explicitly specified
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause as encoded by the GEO overall_survival field; zero-status records are censored at the source-provided follow-up
